items.title: Quantum computing is helping AT&T solve network problems in seconds: D-Wave CEO
items.summary: D-Wave Quantum (QBTS) has transferred its listing on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) to the Nasdaq (^IXIC). The quantum computing company has also expanded its network optimization deal with AT&T (T). D-Wave Quantum CEO and president Alan Baratz sits down with Julie Hyman to talk more about its optimization goals for AT&T and other clients.

items.title: Ford Jumps 6%, Outstrips GM and Tesla on Q2 Earnings Beat, Raised 2026 Guidance, Citi Upgrade

items.title: Citi upgrades Ford to Buy on improving F-Series momentum, lifts PT to $20
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi upgraded Ford Motor to Buy from Neutral and raised its price target to $20 from $19, saying improving F-Series pickup production, easing warranty costs and better aluminum supply are driving a positive shift in the automaker's earnings outlook.

items.title: Ford Stock Jumps On Upgrade, Earnings Beat; Are Its EV Woes In The Rear View Mirror?
items.summary: Ford stock rose sharply on Wednesday morning after the Detroit automaker reported mixed second-quarter results and raised its full-year guidance, earnings a quick upgrade to buy from Citi.  The analyst's note cited improving momentum and placed a price target at 20, 34% above where Ford stock ended Tuesday.  Shares of Ford were up around 5.5% in Wednesday's premarket trading, according to MarketSurge.
